what: an exploded view moving the arm 30 mm up, shown
method: Base: box 20x20x10 from (-10,-10,-10), grounded; Arm: box 40x10x10 from (0,-5,0), centre (20,0,5); the view moves Arm by (0,0,30). explode.show is shown only (the design keeps its placements), so occurrence.properties reports Arm where the design places it: centre (20,0,5)
